sources.snippet: This model card focuses on the model associated with the Stable Diffusion v2-1-base model. This stable-diffusion-2-1-base model fine-tunes stable-diffusion-2-base (512-base-ema.ckpt) with 220k extra steps taken, with punsafe=0.98 on the same dataset.

sources.title: stable-diffusion-2-1-base: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview stable-diffusion-2-1-base is a latent diffusion model for text-to-image generation developed by Manojb that fine-tunes the base Stable Diffusion 2 model with 220,000 additional training steps using a higher NSFW filtering threshold (p_unsafe=0.98) on the same LAION-5B dataset.
